calls.title: Opendoor<>GrowthBook - Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting addressed urgent contract negotiations between OpenDoor and Growthbook, emphasizing a need to finalize terms and pricing amidst limited legal resources. Abbie Thomsen highlighted the critical end-of-month deadline, and Jake Heier discussed potential pricing flexibility due to budget constraints. The team sought to reduce the contract from $210K to $170K, with a possible 10% discount through marketing collaboration that would enhance OpenDoor's profile. Legal and procurement processes were actively moving forward, with a single lawyer at OpenDoor prioritizing contract review. Both parties showed commitment to open communication and a strong partnership, highlighting operational readiness following a successful POC phase.
calls.keywords: Pricing negotiation, contract addendum, legal review, InfoSec security, procurement process, marketing collaboration
